critical_code_review_comments: NovaChatPanel.tsx isLoading branch (line 440-453) correctly replaces the static italic 'Nova is thinking...' with chat-typing-indicator bubble containing chat-typing-indicator-text (tx fallback 'Nova is typing') + NovaTypingDots. Both data-testid and testID are set (dual attrs for RN web + native).

NovaTypingDots.tsx implements 3 Animated.Value dots (0.25→1 opacity loop, 320ms duration, staggered by 160ms via Animated.delay). useNativeDriver=true (warning about missing RCTAnimation is JS-fallback for RN-Web and is expected/harmless).
Loop cleanup on unmount is present (return () => loops.forEach((loop) => loop.stop())) — no leaked animations.

tx() helper correctly falls back to 'Nova is typing' when the i18n key is missing, ensuring the label is always populated. For French locale, help.chat.novaTyping resolves to 'Nova est en train d'écrire' (confirmed line 6455 of /app/frontend/src/i18n/locales/fr.ts).

Handoff is seamless: typing indicator conditionally renders on isLoading=true (line 440), separate from the messages.map() loop, so the moment isLoading flips to false and the new assistant message is appended, the typewriter (useNovaTypewriter) auto-detects the fresh assistant message and starts reveal. Measured gap between indicator disappearance and cursor appearance was ~200ms — well within one render tick.

Note (informational, not a bug): a separate string 'Nova is thinking...' still exists in /app/frontend/src/components/help/FAQSection.tsx:358 for the 'Ask Nova AI' inline FAQ button. That is an unrelated surface (not NovaChatPanel) — if consistency is desired, main agent could migrate it to help.chat.novaTyping too. Non-blocking.
